subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should `run.execution_phase` become a supported long-term public diagnostic/plugin-SDK event, rather than remaining private embedded-runner callback data?
rationale: The patch is structurally additive and has focused evidence, but exporting a new discriminated-union event establishes an external consumer contract that tests alone cannot permanently select.

options.title: Sponsor the public event
options.body: Accept the additive event contract, resolve the branch against current main, and refresh the public diagnostics proof on the resulting head.

options.title: Keep phases private
options.body: Decline the public plugin-SDK event and retain startup-phase handling only in existing internal status/control paths.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the public event
recommendation.body: Accept the additive event contract, resolve the branch against current main, and refresh the public diagnostics proof on the resulting head.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-head authorship and assignment provide the clearest evidence of ownership for the pending diagnostics API decision.
